{{Quote|I want to be a journalist so I can help people. I mean, that's not why I wanted to be a journalist to start with. I wanted to travel and see the galaxy, and I did, and now it kind of seems like I wasn't doing anything important. And we all need to feel like we're important, right?|Yara Grugara|<ref name="Conversations With Lanius">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20031023lanius|text=Conversations With Lanius}}</ref>}}
'''Yara Grugara''' was a reporter for [[Cularin Central Broadcasting]]'s [[Eye on Cularin]], who interviewed [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Lanius Qel-Bertuk]] about the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and love. She would also interview the [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Nirama]].
